verdicts.reason: A: the jar sits high in the full circle, leaving a large empty purple area below it; the logo is pushed onto the same baseline as the attribution, so the two fight for attention and the logo no longer reads as a separate sign-off; the quote block sinks to the bottom, leaving a wide empty gap under the quote mark. B: it keeps the original's structure (circle bleeding off the bottom-right corner, logo bottom-left, attribution under the quote), wraps the quote cleanly into 3 lines and centres the jar in the circle; its only flaws are minor: the jar and its 'SOLSTICE' label are small, and the quote mark floats a little far above the text.
